steps.name: owner created three least-privilege tokens (agent, integrator, reader) through RLS
Codex starts from an EMPTY directory and rebuilds the verified mainline from the exchange only
3-4 Codex exports delivery A (gates run locally) and the exchange receives it
Codex exports delivery C (will conflict with A)
agent token cannot publish, list the inbox or approve (28000)
5 integrator verified the three packages (quarantine + dry merge, nothing executed from them)
6-7 A merged and gates passed; C detected as CONFLICT and NOT merged; B waits for the owner
8 new mainline published, backed up locally and RESTORED byte-identical in an empty directory
owner approved the sensitive delivery in Avalon → Library → Code (iPhone profile, no overflow)
after the owner approval the integrator merged B, ran the gates and published
10 Codex syncs the new verified mainline (contains A and B, not C) and can keep working on it
Codex sees the outcome of each delivery (A integrated, B integrated, C failed with conflicts)
local backups exist for every published mainline (bundle + sha256 + manifest)
revoking a token cuts access immediately
